flavor: A swirling vortex of translucent silk and silver chains hangs suspended in the center of a hollowed mountain peak. Within the eye of the cyclone, a creature of condensed storm-clouds drifts, its eyes glowing like lightning trapped in amber.
name: The Gale-Bound Reliquary
reason: The party encounters a celestial-aligned demon bound by wind-magic, offering cryptic prophecies in exchange for breath or song.
